messages:
Maya Kaur: FYI nightly billing-import failed for batch ns-batch-20260114-04. NetSuite rejected rows with 'line_description too long' and the import retried, creating 4 duplicate Stripe drafts. Dropping context + proposed mitigation.

billing-runner-bot: [alert] billing-import-nightly job 1771234567 FAILED -> NetSuiteError: LINE_DESCRIPTION_EXCEEDS_LIMIT (200) batch=ns-batch-20260114-04

Ravi Shah: Can you attach the invoice payload that caused the rejection? want to see which field grew.

Maya Kaur: sample payload (redacted):
```json
{
  "stripe_invoice_id": "in_7XyzA...",
  "customer": "cus_9Fgh...",
  "lines": [
    {
      "amount": 42000,
      "description": "Pro+Addons; seats=400; notes={\\"deploy\\":\\"prod:svc-77;commit=b4f9c3e;trace=LongExceptionStack: at x->y->z ...\\"}",
      "quantity": 1
    }
  ],
  "metadata": {"billing_period":"2026-01-13"}
}
```

Sam R.: Root cause: recent change in usage-report (commit b4f9c3e) started appending verbose deploy metadata into invoice line descriptions. That routinely exceeds NetSuite's 200 char limit. Our import pipeline retries on failure, and each retry recreates Stripe draft invoices -> duplicates.

Lina V.: Short-term mitigation: sanitize/truncate the line description at generation time for both Stripe and the NetSuite CSV. Minimal change in transform layer:
```py
MAX=200
if len(desc) > MAX:
    desc = desc[:MAX-3] + "..."
```
Also add server-side validation to prevent creating Stripe lines longer than 200 chars.

Maya Kaur: I'll push the truncate hotfix to staging now and run a test import. If green, will push to prod in the emergency window. I'll also manually void the 4 duplicate drafts in Stripe and ensure nothing was posted to NetSuite.

billing-runner-bot: [info] billing-import-nightly job 1771234680 STARTED

Maya Kaur: Staging hotfix applied at 1771234720, staging import SUCCESS. Promoting to prod (deploy https://deploys.redwood/prod/14102).

billing-runner-bot: [info] billing-import-nightly job 1771234890 STARTED

Maya Kaur: Prod import finished at 1771234898, status=SUCCESS. No new duplicates. Manual cleanup performed: voided 4 Stripe drafts. No invoices were posted to NetSuite (rejected earlier), accounting confirmed no revenue impact. Created ticket FIN-2026-102 for postmortem and remediation.

Ana Gomez: Thanks. Action items for FIN-2026-102: 1) eng-payments + eng-ml to root cause why deploy metadata was added to descriptions (owner: Ravi), 2) move verbose metadata into invoice.metadata and stop embedding debug traces in human-facing fields, 3) add CI guard that validates line description <= 200 chars, 4) add an alert to detect duplicate draft churn > 1 in a single run. Please include estimated dollars affected and approvals for hotfix in the ticket.
